objective: Maximize long-run expected GP growth, not headline ROI. Prefer high probability-weighted GP per unit time, scalable capacity, reliable execution, low player-time cost and low correlation.

capacity_model.rule: Capacity is a conservative model of how much can be deployed without assuming the visible one-unit edge scales indefinitely. It is not a guaranteed fill size.

execution_model.rule: Execution probabilities are ranking heuristics based on observed flow/freshness and are never presented as guaranteed fill odds. Fast flips expose separate entry, exit and round-trip cumulative probability curves instead of a single undifferentiated execution number.

real_execution_learning.rule: User-confirmed GE orders are the highest-quality execution evidence. Empirical fill curves may blend into model probabilities only after minimum sample thresholds; unknown timestamps never become negative samples.

spread_persistence.rule: A fast flip is not automatic-allocation eligible until its spread survives at least three consecutive snapshots and ten minutes with fresh HIGH/LOW prints, both sides trading, adequate turnover and retained positive after-tax edge.

player_time.rule: Manual processing is charged against an explicit configurable shadow value of player time. Show raw profit and player-time-adjusted profit separately.

ge_slots.rule: Rank slot use by probability-weighted GP per GE-slot-hour after execution, tax, slippage and player-time adjustment. Unknown non-desk GE orders mean free-slot counts are upper bounds, not facts.

order_price_optimizer.allocation_authority_rule: The optimizer may change automatic frontier economics only after the underlying fast-flip spread is PERSISTENT_SPREAD or REPEATABLE_MARKET. FLASH/UNSTABLE/INVALID spreads receive advisory prices only.

slot_architecture.rule: ACTIVE slots prioritize short-cycle realized velocity, PARKING slots hold patient evergreen/crash-catcher orders, and FLEXIBLE is reserved for relative-value or opportunistic use. The targets are soft and never override materially better GP per slot-hour.

rollout.rule: Phase 2 consumes Phase 1 persistence and real-execution outputs. It must not bypass the persistence gate or treat modeled optimal prices as guaranteed fills.

minimum_absolute_profit_hurdles.evaluation_basis: Probability-weighted expected profit at modeled capacity after tax, slippage, execution probability and any player-time shadow cost.
minimum_absolute_profit_hurdles.promotion_rule: Observe at least 12 relay cycles and 50 evaluated candidates. Promote only after review confirms the hurdles reduce low-value slot use without suppressing repeatable realized GP; changing rollout_status to ALLOCATION_AUTHORITATIVE is an explicit later decision.
minimum_absolute_profit_hurdles.rule: A high percentage return or GP/hour estimate does not justify a GE slot when the modeled absolute payout is too small to overcome operational friction and model error. Bucket-specific priors are deliberately conservative and remain advisory during observation.

capital_aging.rule: Dead capital becomes progressively less competitive even if the original thesis has not fully invalidated. Hold-for-use gear is exempt.

shadow_learning.rule: Shadow signals are research observations, not claimed executions. Real user-confirmed fills remain the higher-quality evidence source.

value_graph.rule: Mechanical edges compete directly against speculative trades after tax, capacity, labor and liquidity.
